newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela inflation up 6 pct on labor deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela inflation up 6 pct on labor deal - paper.

text.p: The inflationary impact of Venezuela's severance pay agreement announced last Monday will be six percent, according to Planning Ministry estimates, the financial daily Economia Hoy reported Monday.
The agreement, due to be sent to Congress shortly, will see private sector employers pay, in cash, one quarter of accumulated severance payments to their employees over the next six months.
Public sector employees will receive 150,000 bolivars ($314) in cash and short-term government securities over the same period.
Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said last week the labor deal would add a few points to the year's inflation, although he added this year's 35 percent inflation target was still valid.
